key_decisions: Adopt per-test sandbox for restore suite
summary: Hardened restore snapshot helpers and refactored tests to use sandbox repos without regex escapes.

topics.issue: Regex escaping brittle for remote names
topics.resolution: Switched to fixed-string filtering and cleaner nocasematch state
topics.what: Reworked git config capture to avoid regex and clarified nocasematch handling
topics.why: Snapshot state failed on special chars

topics.resolution: Now use setup sandbox, fixed-string greps, expanded coverage
topics.what: Converted tests to per-test sandboxes and added ordering assertions
topics.why: CI read-only failures and missing order checks
